8.6.3.31 OperationCycle
[SWS_Dem_00601] Definition of ClientServerInterface OperationCycle ⌈
Name
OperationCycle
Comment
Provides the capability to set the state of an operation cycle. One port of this interface type is
provided per operation cycle by the Dem Service Component. It has OperationCycleId as a
port-defined argument.
IsService
true
Variation
–
0
E_OK
Operation successful
Possible Errors
